| Quote | Annual premium | Deductible | Limit |
|---|---|---|---|
| Small deductible plan | $139,035 | $2,500 | $1,000,000 |
| Guaranteed cost | $149,500 | $0 | $1,000,000 |

The customer has both quotes in front of them, and both are valid until 20 Oct. [Option 3](/lightning/r/0Q0aj000003aaODCAY/view) is still a draft and has no price yet, so it isn't part of this comparison.
